SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T3.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T3.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS ConsumptionDiff 
FROM transactions_1k T1 
JOIN customers T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
JOIN yearmonth T3 ON T2.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID AND YEAR(T3.Date) = 2012

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption_Diff
FROM 
  customers T1
  INNER JOIN yearmonth T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE 
  T1.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM T2.Date) = 2012

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption_Difference
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN (
  SELECT CustomerID, MIN(Date) AS MinDate
  FROM yearmonth
  GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID
JOIN (
  SELECT CustomerID, MAX(Date) AS MaxDate
  FROM yearmonth
  GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS T4 ON T1.CustomerID = T4.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2012-12-31'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'CZK' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN T2.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS Diff 
FROM customers T1 
JOIN yearmonth T2 
ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE T2.Date LIKE '%/%/12';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption_Difference
FROM transactions_1k
JOIN customers ON transactions_1k.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
JOIN yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012';
